# Department of Holistic Education (DHE)

> National holistic education platform under Vidya Bharti / VBITR Trust — 25 cells, year-round programs, NEP 2020, Viksit Bharat. Shiksha Mahakumbh Abhiyan is the flagship annual summit (Event Management Cell), not the whole of DHE.

## Official site

- https://www.dhe.org.in
